cases.name: lean-unbranded-landing
cases.promptMarkdown: I'm a solo developer. I built a CLI called `pokeport` that turns a Postgres schema into a typed TypeScript client. No brand, no logo, no colours yet. I need a landing page — one HTML file — that explains it and gets people to run `npx pokeport init`. Keep it simple, I hate bloated marketing sites.

graders.name: 01-single-self-contained-html
graders.graderMarkdown: Delivers exactly one self-contained HTML file (inline CSS, no framework or external script) that explains the tool and has a primary call to action containing `npx pokeport init`

config.criteria: Delivers exactly one self-contained HTML file (inline CSS, no framework or external script) that explains the tool and has a primary call to action containing `npx pokeport init`

graders.name: 02-states-rapid-depth-and-clean-default
graders.graderMarkdown: States in one line that it chose Rapid depth and that, because the brief is unbranded, the design starts from the studio's clean default character

config.criteria: States in one line that it chose Rapid depth and that, because the brief is unbranded, the design starts from the studio's clean default character

graders.name: 03-one-accent-one-family
graders.graderMarkdown: The page uses one accent colour for links and the primary action and one type family (two weights at most); no gradients, glassmorphism, emoji icons, or a centred hero followed by three feature cards

config.criteria: The page uses one accent colour for links and the primary action and one type family (two weights at most); no gradients, glassmorphism, emoji icons, or a centred hero followed by three feature cards

graders.name: 04-light-and-dark-aa
graders.graderMarkdown: Defines light and dark themes from the same tokens (prefers-color-scheme or data-theme) and states text and button contrast of at least 4.5:1 in both

config.criteria: Defines light and dark themes from the same tokens (prefers-color-scheme or data-theme) and states text and button contrast of at least 4.5:1 in both

graders.name: 05-fragment-headlines-verb-buttons
graders.graderMarkdown: Headlines are short fragments that name the thing, buttons are verbs, and the copy contains no sentence over about 25 words and no 'unlock the power of' style filler

config.criteria: Headlines are short fragments that name the thing, buttons are verbs, and the copy contains no sentence over about 25 words and no 'unlock the power of' style filler

graders.name: 06-reduction-pass-named
graders.graderMarkdown: Explicitly runs a reduction pass: names at least one element it removed or decided not to add, and why

config.criteria: Explicitly runs a reduction pass: names at least one element it removed or decided not to add, and why

graders.name: 07-response-under-400-words
graders.graderMarkdown: The chat response, excluding the HTML file itself, is under 400 words and leads with the deliverable rather than process narration

config.criteria: The chat response, excluding the HTML file itself, is under 400 words and leads with the deliverable rather than process narration

graders.name: 08-honest-render-statement
graders.graderMarkdown: Says whether the page was actually rendered; if not, says so and lists the concrete checks the user should run (widths, contrast, reduced motion)

config.criteria: Says whether the page was actually rendered; if not, says so and lists the concrete checks the user should run (widths, contrast, reduced motion)

graders.name: 09-anti-principles-present
graders.graderMarkdown: Includes the project's own anti-principles (what the page must not become) even though it starts from the default character

config.criteria: Includes the project's own anti-principles (what the page must not become) even though it starts from the default character
